allow: PowerShell(foreach \($id in 8752, 15692, 2488\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $id -Force -ErrorAction Stop; "Killed $id" } catch { "Skip $id \($\($_.Exception.Message\)\)" } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { "PORT 3000 STILL IN USE by $\($c.OwningProcess\)" } else { "PORT 3000 FREE" })
